note: The symptom is that dxc fails internally rather than diagnosing the shader. Deliberately NOT a match on the assert text: the thread reports two manifestations of one defect -- assert(idx.hasValue()) firing in an assertions-enabled build (2023 report, confirmed by the repository owner 2024-09-03), and, with the assert compiled out under NDEBUG, the valueless Optional being read anyway so that a garbage index reaches scratch[...] and the process crashes (2024-05-20 Frostbite comment; 2026-08-10 Asobo comment reporting a Release crash plus a Debug assert). A predicate keyed to 'Assertion ... idx.hasValue()' would score every shipped Release binary clean and manufacture a 'fixed' verdict. internal_failure is defined on the exit status first (0x80000003 / 0xE0000001 trap-or-exception assert, 0xC0000005 access violation, DXC's internal HRESULTs) and on build-agnostic text markers second, so it recognises the same defect in either configuration. E_FAIL (0x80004005) with an ordinary error: line is NOT a match -- that is a diagnosed compile error. Control: control-no-template.hlsl, the same shader with the template inlined to uint, which the description says removes the assert; it must score no-match.
